descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We are seeking an experienced Software Developer to help modernize a mission-critical Portfolio Management System (PMS) used by investment professionals across front-office investment functions.
 The successful candidate will play a key role in transforming a mature WPF-based desktop platform into a modern, scalable, high-performance application ecosystem. The work includes UI modernization, platform upgrades, API development, performance optimization, architecture simplification, technical debt reduction, and AI-enabled user experiences.
 This role is well suited to an engineer with experience in buy-side portfolio, order, execution, risk, or investment analytics platforms who is comfortable working across desktop, web, service, integration, and data layers.
 Responsibilities: 
 Key Responsibilities:
 Application Modernization
 • Upgrade and modernize existing .NET, WPF, and DevExpress applications.
 • Refactor legacy components, reduce technical debt, and improve maintainability.
 • Improve the application user experience while preserving critical front-office workflows.
 • Contribute to target architecture decisions and phased modernization plans.
 Performance Engineering
 • Investigate and resolve application freezing, slow response times, memory leaks, and crashes.
 • Profile and optimize desktop, server-side, database, and integration components.
 • Improve data loading, caching, processing, and resource-management patterns.
 • Implement appropriate diagnostics, logging, health monitoring, and performance measures.
 Architecture Simplification
 • Reduce reliance on legacy SOA, middleware, and tightly coupled dependencies.
 • Design simpler service-oriented and API-first components.
 • Support migration toward modular, scalable, and supportable architecture patterns.
 • Assess MongoDB dependencies and recommend pragmatic simplification or replacement approaches.
 API and Integration Development
 • Design and build secure RESTful APIs for PMS data access.
 • Develop integrations with trading, risk, reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
 • Implement authentication, authorization, validation, auditing, observability, and error handling.
 • Produce clear API specifications and technical documentation.
 AI Enablement
 • Build an AI-powered prompt/chat experience within the PMS.
 • Integrate enterprise Large Language Models and approved AI services.
 • Develop prompt orchestration, tool-calling, retrieval, guardrails, and workflow automation capabilities.
 • Partner with investment users to identify and deliver high-value, controlled AI use cases.
 Web and Desktop Delivery
 • Maintain and enhance rich desktop capabilities while introducing web-based applications where appropriate.
 • Deliver across frontend, backend, service, integration, and data layers.
 • Apply automated testing, code review, secure development, and CI/CD practices.
 Mandatory Skills Description: 
 • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience delivering enterprise applications.
 • Strong C# and .NET experience, including legacy .NET Framework and modern .NET versions.
 • Deep experience with WPF, XAML, MVVM, desktop application architecture, and multithreading.
 • Buy-side investment technology experience, particularly in one or more of the following areas: Portfolio Management Systems (PMS) , Order Management Systems (OMS), Execution Management Systems (EMS), Front-office trading applications, Fixed income, equities, FX, derivatives, swaps, options, TRS, or CDS workflows
 • Hands-on DevExpress experience, including complex grids and performance-sensitive user interfaces.
 • Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs using ASP.NET Core or equivalent technologies.
 • Python development experience for services, automation, analytics, or AI-related components.
 • Strong SQL Server development and performance-tuning skills.
 • Experience creating both web-based applications and rich desktop/fat-client applications.
 • Practical expertise in profiling, diagnostics, memory management, performance tuning, and production troubleshooting.
 • Experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, and Azure DevOps or similar engineering platforms.
 Nice-to-Have Skills Description: 
 • React, Angular, or comparable modern web framework experience.
 • MongoDB and data-access modernization experience.
 • Microservices, modular monolith, event-driven, or message-based architecture experience.
 • Microsoft Azure, containerization, Kubernetes, and enterprise API management experience.
 • Experience integrating LLMs, AI assistants, retrieval-augmented generation, tool-calling, or enterprise AI gateways.
 • Familiarity with application security, data entitlements, auditability, and regulated environments.
